title: C.H.U.D.
review: New York in 80s movies always looks either lavish and excessive, like in {The Wolf of Wall Street} or destitute and filthy like in {Do the Right Thing}. They made the right decision to avoid showing the titular chuds until deep into the movie. It starts as relatively serious detective drama about a conspiracy to cover up the existence of the chuds. They could have been alien abductors instead, and it would slot right in next to all the other sci-fi movies that use the same template. It's not good good, but it's silly in a good way. I've seen a lot of horror movies that tried to be just like this, and failed miserably.
